import type { Count } from './types';
declare const count: Count;
declare const optional: number | undefined;
declare const enabled: boolean;
declare const rows: { total?: number }[];
declare const payload: { count?: number } | undefined;
declare function identity<T>(value: T): T;
const alias = count;
const content = alias && <span>Alias</span>;
export const cases = <>
  {count && <span>Count</span>}
  {optional && <span>Optional</span>}
  {payload?.count && <span>Optional property</span>}
  {enabled ? count && <span>Nested</span> : optional && <span>Other</span>}
  {enabled && (count && <span>Chained</span>)}
  {content}
  {rows.map(row => row.total && <span>Mapped</span>)}
  {[count && <span>Array</span>]}
  {(count && <span>Nullish does not remove zero</span>) ?? null}
</>;
export function Returned() { return count && <span>Returned</span>; }
export const Arrow = () => optional && <span>Arrow</span>;
